newsitem.title: NORWAY: Norsk Hydro rises ahead of H1 results.
newsitem.headline: Norsk Hydro rises ahead of H1 results.

text.p: Norsk Hydro ASA shares rose around three percent on Wednesday in relatively high trade. The company will release its first half results next week

At 1323 GMT, Hydro stood 3.23 percent up at 415 crowns, just below an intraday and all-time high at 417 crowns. Trade in Hydro amounted to 116 million crowns of the session's total turnover so far of 535 million crowns.
"There are many small buyers in Hydro today and at the same time many large Norwegian investors have already sold over the past few weeks, so there's generally a lack of sellers," said one broker.
Norsk Hydro will publish the results on Monday. A Reuter poll of nine analysts forecast pre-tax profits of 6.09 billion crowns, slightly down from 6.14 billion crowns a year ago.
